content.short: Perpetual futures come first at BloFin, which offers USDT, USDC and coin-margined contracts plus spot and copy trading.
content.description: BloFin is built for futures traders. It lists high-leverage perpetual contracts margined in USDT, USDC or the coin itself, covering BTC, ETH and many smaller pairs. Spot trading, copy trading and earn products sit in the same unified account, so margin does not need to be shuffled between wallets. Customer assets are held with Fireblocks custody. The exchange has added TradFi markets such as gold, oil and US stocks, AI-powered trading bots and a rewards hub for new users.
